items.title: Face aux feu qui ravagent la Méditerranée, le Nord du Maroc en état d'alerte
items.description: Les autorités marocaines ont placé la région de Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceïma sous un niveau élevé de vigilance face au risque d'incendies de forêt, dans un contexte marqué par la multiplication des feux à travers le bassin méditerranéen. Les épisodes qui touchent plusieurs pays voisins ont conduit les différents services concernés à renforcer leur coordination et leur capacité d'intervention afin de prévenir tout embrasement de grande ampleur. Cette mobilisation a été mise à l'épreuve samedi avec un incendie déclaré dans la forêt de El Kitane, située sur le territoire de la commune de Zaitoun, dans la périphérie de Tétouan. Selon Saïd Ben Jira, directeur régional de l'Agence nationale des eaux et forêts (ANEF) pour la région Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceïma, le sinistre a pu être maîtrisé « de manière professionnelle et rapide », grâce à une coordination opérée « au plus haut niveau » entre les différents intervenants. L'incendie a immédiatement mobilisé d'importants moyens terrestres et aériens afin d’empêcher la propagation des flammes vers les massifs forestiers voisins. Dans une déclaration à Hespress , le responsable a souligné que « l'intervention rapide de la Protection civile, des Forces armées royales, des autorités provinciales et locales, de l'Agence nationale des eaux et forêts, des Forces auxiliaires ainsi que de la population a permis de circonscrire puis d'éteindre le feu ». D'après les premières estimations communiquées par l'ANEF, environ cinq hectares de végétation ont été détruits. Les opérations de lutte contre l'incendie ont mobilisé deux avions bombardiers d'eau de type Canadair ainsi qu'un hélicoptère de la Gendarmerie royale. Ce déploiement a permis de protéger une superficie forestière estimée à près de 2.000 hectares, qui risquait d'être atteinte par les flammes. Alors que les températures continuent de grimper dans le nord du Royaume, les autorités assurent maintenir l'ensemble de leurs dispositifs en état d'alerte. « Tous les intervenants sont pleinement mobilisés pour faire face à tout départ de feu susceptible de se produire dans la région », a affirmé Saïd Ben Jira. Le responsable a également appelé les habitants des provinces septentrionales ainsi que les estivants à faire preuve d'une vigilance accrue en évitant toute pratique susceptible de provoquer un incendie et en signalant immédiatement tout départ de feu. Il a insisté sur le caractère déterminant de la rapidité d'intervention, estimant qu'une alerte précoce augmente significativement les chances de contenir un incendie avant qu'il ne prenne de l'ampleur. Le renforcement de la vigilance au Maroc intervient dans un contexte régional particulièrement préoccupant. Plusieurs pays du pourtour méditerranéen, parmi lesquels l'Algérie, la Tunisie, l'Espagne, la France, l'Italie et le Portugal, sont confrontés depuis plusieurs jours à des incendies d'une intensité exceptionnelle. Cette situation conduit les autorités marocaines à adapter leur dispositif de prévention et de lutte face aux risques accrus liés à un été marqué par des températures particulièrement élevées. À travers le bassin méditerranéen, ces incendies continuent de menacer de vastes territoires, obligeant des centaines de milliers de personnes à quitter leur domicile. Attisés par des vents soutenus et des conditions climatiques extrêmes, les feux demeurent difficiles à maîtriser. Plusieurs des pays concernés ont par ailleurs fait état de victimes mortelles, illustrant la gravité d'une saison estivale placée sous le signe d'un risque incendie particulièrement élevé. The post Face aux feu qui ravagent la Méditerranée, le Nord du Maroc en état d'alerte appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
items.description: The man suspected of carrying out what authorities say was likely an “Islamist terror attack” at Berlin Pride has been shot and killed by police. Officers opened fire when Abdul Ballout, a 21-year-old German citizen with Lebanese heritage, rushed at them with a knife in Spandau, a western borough of Berlin. It brought an end to a massive manhunt that was launched after a white van was driven into a crowd of people near Tiergarten park just before 22:00 (local time) on Saturday evening, killing one woman and injuring at least 29 others. Police say following the ramming, several people were injured in a stabbing attack. Investigators at the scene in Tiergarten park on Sunday Speaking to reporters on Sunday, German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt said evidence pointed to it being an “Islamist terror attack”. “We are dealing with a suspected perpetrator, who had previously drawn attention to himself through a high volume of criminal offences, radicalisation and affiliation with the Islamist scene,” Dobrindt said. A statement released by the Berlin public prosecutor’s office revealed further details about Ballout’s criminal history. In May 2025, prosecutors said he travelled via Turkey to Lebanon, with the intention of joining the Islamic State group (IS) in Syria. While in Lebanon, he allegedly made contact with several individuals he believed were members of IS. He was arrested in Lebanon in July 2025 and sentenced to three months in prison for incitement to religious and sectarian conflict. Then, in November 2025, he returned to Germany, where he was arrested at Berlin Brandenburg Airport and held in pre-trial detention. In May this year, he was sentenced to one year and 10 months in prison for “preparing a serious act of violence endangering the state”. The decision was deferred for six months and he was placed under the supervision of a parole officer. He was previously convicted of assault and robbery in 2022, and of robbing a victim of headphones in 2020. Abdul Ballout was shot and killed in a police operation on Sunday afternoon Dobrindt said Germany’s threat level would be raised following the attack, while other states were also being briefed about the attack and advised to review their security measures for major events. On Sunday, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited the scene of the attack in Tiergarten park. He later spoke outside a church service that paid tribute to victims, where he pledged to “defend the freedom and openness of our lives”. “These extremists have no place in our society,” he said, adding that Germany would not allow the “poison of terrorism” to affect its society. Berlin police have said people were hit on Ahornsteig street, which is a long path stretching across the Tiergarten park, largely in a forested area. Meanwhile, German media say those injured in the attack are no longer in a life-threatening condition. Saturday’s attack shattered the joy and revelry of Berlin’s Christopher Street Day, where hundreds of thousands spill onto the city streets for one of Europe’s most famous Pride events. Christopher Street Day commemorates the first known uprising among the LGBT community in New York City in 1969 at the Stonewall Inn, which is located on Christopher Street. A clean-up event due to take place at Tiergarten park and a breakfast market scheduled for Sunday morning were both cancelled following the attack. Later in the day, some members of the LGBT community returned to the iconic Brandenburg Gate for an impromptu vigil. Speakers condemned extremism in all its manifestations, but they also criticised the government for a lack of support, singling out recent budget cuts for queer organisations. Armin Duenhoelter from Wolfsburg, who works as a drag artist, was backstage at the main stage when the attack happened. He told Agency France-Presse that he was still shocked but vowed to be back for next year’s pride celebration. “We won’t let it beat us down,” he said.

items.title: Le président du Faso à la 25è promotion de l'AMGN : « Soyez dignes de votre choix (…) l'autorité ne s'impose pas, elle se mérite »
items.description: Capitaine Ibrahim Traoré, président du Faso, chef de l'État, chef suprême des Forces armées nationales a, dans la soirée de samedi 25 juillet 2026 à Pô, dans la région du Nazinon, présidé la cérémonie de sortie officielle de la 25è promotion des Elèves-Officiers d'Active de l'Académie militaire Georges-Namoano. Ce sont au total 217 nouveaux Sous-lieutenants que l'Académie militaire Georges-Namoano met au service du Burkina Faso et de neuf pays d'Afrique, notamment le Cameroun, la République centrafricaine, Djibouti, la Guinée, le Mali, le Niger, le Sénégal, le Tchad et le Togo. ‎Le contingent burkinabè de la présente promotion de l'AMGN est fort de 199 Officiers. ‎La promotion est parrainée par le général Kassoum Coulibaly, ancien ministre en charge de la défense et actuel ambassadeur du Burkina auprès des Etats-Unis d'Amérique. Elle a pour nom de baptême : « Lieutenant Sawadogo Alexandre Bienvenu », en hommage à ce valeureux Officier tombé au champ d'honneur pour la Patrie en février 2022.‎ ‎Le chef d'État-major général des Armées, le général de division, Moussa Diallo a appelé les nouveaux Sous-lieutenants à faire preuve d'intégrité et de loyauté dans leurs Nations respectives. Il les a donc instruits à bannir « la facilité, l'arrogance, la corruption et la traîtrise ».‎ Bannir « la facilité, l'arrogance, la corruption et la traîtrise » Cette année, la cérémonie solennelle marquant la fin de formation des Officiers s'est tenue sur le site de la nouvelle Académie en construction. Pour le Commandant de l'AMGN, le Lieutenant-Colonel William Desmond Baguera, cette nouvelle Académie est le « symbole d'une fierté nationale assumée » et de la parole donnée par le Chef de l'État qui a ordonné la construction de cette nouvelle académie. ‎A cette occasion, la 25è promotion s'est vêtue fièrement d'une nouvelle tenue faite en pagne traditionnel Gourmantché ; un pagne porté à la fin des rites d'initiation dans la zone Est du Burkina. Selon le délégué de la promotion, le Sous-lieutenant Abdallah Cédric Ki, la formation pointue, diversifiée et orientée vers les défis du moment, qu'ils ont reçue durant leur passage à l'AMGN, leur permettra d'exercer le noble métier des armes et de conduire des Hommes. ‎Le Chef suprême des Forces armées nationales a, lui, invité les nouveaux Sous-lieutenants à être des chefs, des guides, des gardiens de l'espérance d'un Peuple. « Soyez dignes de votre choix (...), l'autorité ne s'impose pas, elle se mérite », exhorte le président du Faso, capitaine Ibrahim Traoré, par ailleurs président en exercice de la confédération AES, invitant les officiers à faire preuve de courage et d'engagement dans la vision de la Révolution progressiste populaire (RPP). ‎ ‎De la nouvelle Académie, le président du Faso a souligné que sa construction répond à la volonté de bâtir une Armée forte, une Armée endogène face à un monde de prédation. Lefaso.net Source : ‎ Direction de la communication de la Présidence du Faso

items.title: Burnham says he is prepared to call out Trump ‘if right for Britain’
items.description: Andy Burnham says he would be prepared to call out Donald Trump to defend Britain’s “national interest before anything else” if it is the right thing to do, in his first major interview as prime minister. Speaking exclusively to the BBC, Burnham said he had had a good first exchange with Trump, finding him to be “really warm”. But asked twice if he would trust the US president, he did not say, answering, “it’s a changing world, isn’t it, and you just obviously have to call things as they develop”. In the interview, to be broadcast in full on Monday, he said: “I can’t at any point say that I won’t take a different opinion from him [Trump], that I will need to voice a different idea that is right for Britain.” Burnham said: “My strength is remaining close to people, close to the public, that will not change as prime minister.” Asked if he would call out Trump if it was the right thing, he said, “of course”, going on to say: “You have to defend your own national interest before anything else. That’s what you’re required to do if you’re to do this job properly.” Burnham also said he had had “concern” about the president starting the conflict with Iran, and he “wouldn’t hold back from saying what I think is right”. Responding to Burnham’s comments, Shadow Home Secretary Chris Philp said: “Clearly, the US is a long-standing ally. We need to have good relations with them, but if they do something we disagree with, we should honestly say so.” The prime minister would not commit to a date when the government would spend 3% of GDP on defence. His Chancellor, John Healey, resigned from the previous government, saying that unless a commitment was made to spend that amount by 2030, the country would not be safe. But Burnham said: “I appointed my new chancellor very aware of what he had said about the critical importance of defence spending and the position that he had taken about that. “The first challenge facing us both is to ensure that the defence investment plan is fully funded and that’s the thing that’s right in front of us and we need to work that through as we go towards the budget later this year.” Asked again specifically about the commitment to increase defence spending to 3% of GDP, he said: “We’ve got to work out the way of doing that.” Burnham, for the first time, explicitly dismissed the idea of an early general election before 2029, saying: “I’m going to rule it out… I don’t think people want it.” He said his focus instead was on “getting the country back where it should be”. Philp said the Conservatives were ready to fight an election whenever it happens. “It pretty clear to me we are back in business and that the polls suggest that we are pretty much neck and neck with other parties” he said.

items.title: Énergie : le Maroc accélère sa production électrique
items.description: La production d’électricité du Maroc poursuit sa progression, confirmant la montée en puissance graduelle du système électrique national. Selon l’édition 2026 du Statistical Review of World Energy , publiée par l’Energy Institute, le Royaume a produit 45,9 térawattheures (TWh) en 2025, contre 43,7 TWh un an plus tôt, soit une hausse annuelle de 5,3%. Sur dix ans, la croissance moyenne ressort à 4,2% par an, signe d’une évolution de fond plutôt que d’un simple rebond conjoncturel. Le Maroc a porté sa production d'électricité à 45,9 TWh en 2025, soit une hausse de 5,3% sur un an, selon le Statistical Review of World Energy 2026 . Cette progression s'appuie sur le développement continu des capacités renouvelables, même si les combustibles fossiles, en particulier le charbon, continuent d'occuper une place importante dans le mix énergétique national. Cette trajectoire place le Maroc parmi les producteurs d’électricité les plus dynamiques du continent. La production nationale est passée de 30,3 TWh en 2015 à 45,9 TWh en 2025, soit une hausse de plus de 50% en une décennie. Le Royaume reste loin des grands producteurs africains que sont l’Égypte, avec 242,4 TWh, et l’Afrique du Sud, avec 231,1 TWh, mais il affiche une progression régulière qui accompagne l’augmentation des besoins industriels, urbains et domestiques. L’un des principaux enseignements du rapport tient à la place prise par les énergies renouvelables dans cette dynamique. En 2025, elles ont généré 11,5 TWh d’électricité au Maroc, contre 11,3 TWh en 2024. La hausse globale reste modérée, à 2,1%, mais elle masque des évolutions contrastées selon les filières. L’éolien demeure de loin la première source renouvelable du Royaume, avec 9,2 TWh produits, malgré un léger recul de 1,6% sur un an. Le solaire, lui, poursuit sa progression, avec 1,9 TWh, en hausse de 18,3%, tandis que l’hydroélectricité atteint 0,4 TWh, en augmentation de 26%. Les capacités installées confirment cette orientation. À fin 2025, le Maroc disposait de 1.086 MW de puissance solaire, répartis entre 546 MW de photovoltaïque et 540 MW de centrales solaires à concentration (CSP). Cette double composante distingue le modèle marocain, qui ne repose pas uniquement sur le photovoltaïque classique, mais conserve aussi un socle de solaire thermodynamique. Le parc éolien, entièrement terrestre, atteint pour sa part 2.452 MW, contre 2.395 MW un an plus tôt. Au total, le Maroc dispose ainsi de plus de 3,5 GW de capacités installées dans le solaire et l’éolien. Cette base productive traduit la consolidation d’un modèle électrique plus diversifié, appuyé sur des ressources nationales et moins exposé, à terme, aux combustibles importés. Elle montre aussi que la transition énergétique marocaine avance par addition de capacités, davantage que par substitution rapide aux sources conventionnelles. Le rapport rappelle en effet que le système énergétique marocain reste encore fortement dépendant des combustibles fossiles. L’offre totale d’énergie du Royaume atteint 0,99 exajoule en 2025, en hausse de 5,2% sur un an. Le pétrole en constitue toujours la première composante, avec 0,64 exajoule, devant le charbon, à 0,28 exajoule. Le gaz naturel demeure marginal, à 0,03 exajoule, tandis que les renouvelables hors hydro atteignent 0,04 exajoule. En ce qui concerne la situation mondiale, elle est marquée par un basculement important. En 2025, la production mondiale d’électricité a progressé de 3% pour atteindre 32.202 TWh. Pour la première fois, la croissance des énergies renouvelables a suffi à couvrir l’intégralité de l’augmentation de la demande mondiale d’électricité, entraînant un recul de la production issue des combustibles fossiles. Le solaire a été le principal moteur de cette transformation, avec une hausse de 30% et 511 GW de nouvelles capacités installées en une seule année. Les renouvelables représentent désormais 33,4% de la production mondiale d’électricité, dépassant pour la première fois le charbon, dont la part est tombée à 32,6%. The post Énergie : le Maroc accélère sa production électrique appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Trump paused attacks on Iran to make space for talks, US ambassador says
items.description: President Donald Trump has paused attacks on Iran for the second night in a row to give diplomacy more time, the US ambassador to the UN said. Speaking to Fox News on Sunday, Ambassador Mike Waltz said the president was “giving talks some space; he’s giving it a little bit of room”. An Iranian army spokesperson said on Sunday that Tehran had halted “retaliatory” attacks in the region in response. The pause follows nearly two weeks of daily US strikes and tit-for-tat attacks, effectively unravelling the ceasefire struck in June. Asked whether Trump had decided against escalation for now, Waltz told NBC: “I wouldn’t go that far at all. The president is keeping all options on the table.” Waltz also rejected reports in the New York Times that administration officials had warned expanding hostilities could dangerously drain a diminished stockpile of air defence munitions. “The US military… has everything that it needs to conduct this campaign as effectively as it needs to be,” he said. As of Sunday evening, Trump had not spoken publicly on the latest developments, but earlier posted computer-generated images on his Truth Social account that depicted US military planes bombing Iranian ships and Kharg island. Meanwhile, Iran and Oman held several rounds of technical talks in Tehran on Friday and Saturday to discuss management of the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei. Disputes over control of the strait reignited US-Iran tensions earlier this month and it remains a major block to permanently ending the war. Iran and the US signed a memorandum of understanding in June to halt military operations and reopen the strait, as well as to reach an agreement to end the war over the following 60 days. But after Iranian forces attacked tankers in the Strait of Hormuz on 13 July, the US resumed airstrikes on the country and reinstated its naval blockade on Iranian ports. Iran retaliated with attacks on US military facilities and bases across the Middle East, killing four American soldiers. The US strikes have since killed dozens of people, according to Iran’s health ministry. In the UK, new Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said he would meet his US counterpart Pete Hegseth in the coming week to discuss the strait, which is one of the world’s key transport routes for oil, liquid natural gas and other essential commodities. “When it comes to securing maritime freedom and free commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, that’s where we are absolutely aligned,” Streeting told the BBC . Earlier this week, oil prices hit $100 a barrel for the first time since May, as the renewed fighting stoked fears over global energy supplies. As the war nears its fifth month, it remains largely unpopular in the US, with a new poll from CBS/YouGov suggesting 57% of Americans are frustrated about the conflict and only 19% optimistic. Thousands of people have been killed across the Middle East since the US-Israeli war with Iran began in February, official figures show, with the vast majority coming from Iran and Lebanon. President Trump is set to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the White House on Tuesday.

items.title: Meghan calls Harry ‘a charmer’ during MasterChef Australia appearance
items.description: The Duke of Sussex surprised his wife with a video call during her appearance as a guest judge on MasterChef Australia. During the episode, Prince Harry called Meghan to check in, with producers handing her the phone. She greeted him by saying “hi, my love,” and afterwards called him “a charmer”. Contestants were set the task of transforming a staple ingredient into a dish “fit for a duchess”, although the duchess herself urged her fellow judges to “call me Meghan”. Critics were split on the episode, with The Sunday Times calling it “one big gush-fest” while Hello Magazine posted she “made MasterChef Australia her own”. Meghan filmed the episode in Melbourne in April , during a four-day tour of Australia with Prince Harry. The couple, no longer working royals, visited in a private capacity. Their trip combined visits to charitable causes alongside money-making events. Early on in the episode, Meghan was asked what her favourite dish is to make at home. She said it was “a tough one because I have a lot of palettes to appease”, with her British-born husband favouring “meat, potatoes and cream sauce” while she preferred grilled fish. Their two children, Archie and Lilibet, often help with meal preparation and are “great eaters”, she said. “We’re really lucky on that front,” she added. She then urged the chefs to cook something they felt connected to. “What’s the story behind it?” she asked them. When Prince Harry dialled in later on during the episode, Meghan told them: “My husband’s here,” prompting cheers and shocked faces from contestants and spectators. “I wish you could try these, these dishes are fantastic,” she told him, before showing him the food. He signed off by telling her to go and enjoy, adding: “Very sorry to disturb you.” The duchess’s appearance on the latest season of the show was well received by Hello Magazine , which shared a video of the episode online and complimented Meghan for the way she interacted with the chefs. “The Duchess of Sussex gave personal time calls to all the contestants, proving that she’s always so effortlessly elegant,” it wrote. Writing in The Sunday Times , Charlotte Ivers was less impressed, saying her appearance on the show “told us nothing about what she likes or who even will leave the competition”. Social media users were also split, with one viewer writing that Meghan was “warm, gracious and a delight to watch” while another called Prince Harry’s cameo appearance “cringe”. The Duchess of Sussex’s love for cooking has already been documented in her TV series Meghan’s appearance on MasterChef Australia comes after her own lifestyle and cookery show, With Love, Meghan, which sees her share cooking and hosting tips with friends and guests. Her show has secured a nomination at the Daytime Emmy Awards, in the Outstanding Lifestyle Program category. Earlier this month, Prince Harry and Meghan, along with their children Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, visited the UK. Meghan did not make any public appearances, amid a row over security, but the duke and duchess and their two children held a private meeting with King Charles and Queen Camilla at Highgrove House . On Thursday, the duchess posted a collection of photos on Instagram capturing the Sussex family’s summer holiday so far, including several shots of Archie and Lilibet.

items.title: Barcelona pledge support after worker dies
items.description: Barcelona have offered their support to the family of a worker who died during renovations at the club’s Nou Camp stadium. The 54-year-old man is believed to have died as a result of “a blow” while working on the redevelopment on Friday, Catalan regional police said. Emergency services were called to the stadium, which is having its capacity increased to 105,000, but were unable to save his life. An investigation into the incident is under way. “FC Barcelona deeply regrets the death of the worker who lost his life yesterday in the workplace accident that occurred during the renovation works at Spotify Camp Nou,” said the Catalan club. “The club wishes to express its deepest condolences and extend its heartfelt support to his family, friends, and colleagues. “FC Barcelona president Joan Laporta wishes to personally convey his condolences to the family and places himself at their disposal on behalf of the entire club.” Work at the stadium began in June 2023 and is expected to be completed in early 2028.

items.title: Corruption ends once you join APC – Peter Obi
items.description: By Efe Onodjae Presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, NDC, Mr Peter Obi, has said Nigeria’s political parties lack ideology, adding that politicians accused of corruption appear to be absolved once they defect to the ruling All Progressives Congress, APC. Obi dismissed suggestions that the endorsement of President Bola Tinubu by almost all the state governors would guarantee victory in the 2027 presidential election, saying governors do not necessarily represent the wishes of the people. Speaking on Politics Today, a Channels Television programme, he also accused the ruling party of destabilising opposition parties, saying the situation in the African Democratic Congress, ADC, and the NDC mirrors what happened in the Labour Party, LP. He said: “36 governors support the president. The people in the states are not necessarily with them. It is one thing for a governor to support the president and another for the people to support him. The answer is no. What I am asking for is a free, fair and credible election, which will go down as part of his legacy. “That is why I am begging the youths, whose lives and futures are at stake, to come out and join me in demanding free, fair and credible elections. It will go down as part of his legacy. He campaigned as a democrat. He has fought for democracy. This is the time to prove it. “When Yar’Adua became president, he said, ‘The process through which I came into office is faulty, and I am going to ensure that it does not happen again, even if I have to lose.’ He did it. “He demonstrated it through all his actions. All the subsequent elections after him were free, fair and credible. I contested for a second term then, and nothing happened. That was why people like me, Oshiomhole and others were able to win second terms. “For me, there is no political party in Nigeria today that has an ideology. There is none. Otherwise, the ideology of the APC would be that if you are corrupt and you move to the APC, you are no longer corrupt. “What Nigerians need is competency, capacity, compassion, character and commitment. Wherever I find myself, I will continue to preach change. Those things you are talking about will come if you have good people in office. Part of the problem is that those in government have refused to allow stability in the political space. “I will support the opposition. I will encourage the opposition. I will ensure that opposition parties function as effectively as parties in government. “The president said it, and it is happening. When opposition parties are having problems, that is his wish. Because of it, they are destroying the judiciary. “So if I am president today, most of the things you see in our politics will not happen. I will encourage strong opposition parties to emerge. I will ensure that the restrictions we see today, where even the regulator interferes in party affairs, are removed. “The regulator’s job should be strictly to conduct free, fair and credible elections. Political parties should be free to choose their candidates and decide who they want to present for election. “How many parties have I joined? I left the PDP when things were no longer being done according to the rules. I went to the Labour Party. They put fire in it and wanted me to stay there and get burnt. I moved to the NDC. Since I went there, they have carried the same fire there. “What is happening in the ADC, the NDC and what happened in the Labour Party will never happen if I am president of Nigeria. Anybody who tries to do that, even through the judiciary by giving all sorts of rulings, will face the consequences. We must build institutions, and those institutions must allow for fairness.” The post Corruption ends once you join APC – Peter Obi appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Ondo APC: How Aiyedatiwa’s consensus gamble on NASS candidates backfired
items.description: …as NWC knocks out gov’s men By Dayo Johnson, Akure The attempt by the Ondo State All Progressive Congress , APC, leadership, led by Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa, to impose a consensus arrangement for legislative tickets ran into stiff opposition from the start. Trouble began after reports emerged that the party’s national secretariat rejected the governor’s preferred list for both State and National Assembly seats. Despite the signal from Abuja, the governor’s camp pressed ahead. At the end of the primaries, none of Aiyedatiwa’s preferred aspirants survived. The governor, who had vowed to replace most incumbent federal lawmakers, lost the power play as the NWC overturned the results. The Primaries and the Fallout Weeks before the exercise, Aiyedatiwa told stakeholders across the three senatorial districts that consensus would be the preferred mode for the 2026 elections. He mobilised across all 18 LGAs and met with 203 ward councillors, urging them to work for his candidates. He was also reported to have said that only two current National Assembly members would return, while most state lawmakers would be retained for their loyalty. The move put him at odds with the national leadership, which favoured the return of several incumbents. Displeased lawmakers then approached the Minister of Interior, Hon. Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, to serve as their rallying point to seek justice at the party’s Appeal Committee. The petitions by the aggrieved National Assembly members alleged manipulation by state government agents, including council chairmen and political appointees. NWC Steps in, Reshuffles Ondo Tickets Acting on the Appeal Committee report, the APC National Working Committee, NWC, voided the initial results. In a letter dated June 29, 2026 to INEC, jointly signed by National Chairman Prof. Nentawe Goshwe Yilwatda and National Secretary Senator Surajudeen Ajibola Basiru, the NWC released a revised list. It was one of the most extensive reviews of APC primaries ahead of 2027. The NWC said the changes followed due process and complied with the Electoral Act and INEC guidelines. The shake-up affected 2 of 3 senatorial seats and 6 of 9 House of Representatives seats. For the Senate, the NWC replaced Dr. Taiwo Fasoranti with Senator Adeniyi Adegbonmire (SAN) as the APC candidate for Ondo Central Senatorial District. In Ondo North, Senator Olajide Ipinsagba was returned as the party’s candidate, replacing Hon. Gbenga Elegbeleye. However, the Ondo South Senatorial District remained untouched, with former APC National Vice Chairman (South-West), Hon. Isaacs Kekemeke, retaining the party’s ticket. The changes were even more extensive in the House of Representatives, where all six constituencies affected by the appeals witnessed fresh substitutions. In Ilaje/Ese Odo Federal Constituency, former Information Commissioner, Hon. Donald K. Ojogo, replaced Mr. Akingboye Leke. Hon. Festus Olarewaju Akingbaso emerged as the candidate for Idanre/Ifedore Federal Constituency, displacing Hon. Rasaq Obe. For Owo/Ose Federal Constituency, the NWC restored former lawmaker, Hon. Dr. Oluwatimehin Adelegbe, in place of Hon. Kayode Adejana. At the same time, Hon. Okunjimi John Odimayo replaced Hon. Olumuyiwa Daramola in Okitipupa/Irele Federal Constituency. Similarly, Dr. Abiola Makinde lost the APC ticket for Ondo East/Ondo West Federal Constituency to Hon. Dr. Michael Olamidotun Akintomide. At the same time, Hon. Festus Ayodele Adefiranye replaced Oyerinmade Matthew as the party’s candidate for Ile-Oluji/Okeigbo/Odigbo Federal Constituency. Despite the extensive changes, four candidates retained their tickets after the review. They include Hon. Isaacs Kekemeke (Ondo South Senatorial District), Hon. Ifeoluwa Ehindero (Akoko North East/Akoko North West Federal Constituency), Hon. Adegboyega Adefarati (Akoko South East/Akoko South West Federal Constituency), and Hon. Omowunmi Olatunji, who remains the APC’s candidate for Akure North/Akure South Federal Constituency and the only female among the party’s National Assembly flag bearers in the state. Protest, Presidential Displeasure After the NWC decision, protests broke out in Akure. They were allegedly backed by the governor’s camp. The Presidency was said to be displeased, especially after viral videos showed Commissioner for Women Affairs, Dr. Seun Osamaye, and APC Women Leader, Princess Iji-Ayola, leading demonstrations against Tinubu and the NWC. Security agencies, according to reports have been directed to investigate the organisers of the protest. The Commissioner for Information, Mr Idowu Ajanaku, has however denied the commissioners involvement, saying she only received the protesters. Speaking on the protest by the governors loyalists, a party chieftain said: “Ondo was the only APC state where such a protest happened. At the same time, the governor was in Abuja seeking elders to help him meet the President. That’s not how to repay the President who backed his emergence in 2024.” Ondo APC Elders Back NWC, Call for Unity The PBAT Mandate Elders Forum, led by Chief Demola Ijabiyi, endorsed the NWC’s decision. They praised the party leadership for demonstrating courage, fairness, and fidelity to the constitution and guidelines of the APC in the discharge of this important responsibility Ijabiyi said: “The decision reaffirmed that APC is governed by its constitution, not personal preferences”. The elders recalled that it had consistently cautioned against every form of candidate imposition within our party in Ondo State. “We maintained, at every opportunity, that the wishes of party members, the integrity of the nomination process, and the supremacy of the party must never be sacrificed on the altar of personal ambition or political expediency “We therefore call on all concerned to respect the party’s decision, submit to its authority, and channel their energies towards strengthening the APC and ensuring its continued success. “As we move forward, we urge every APC member to embrace reconciliation, mutual respect, and collective responsibility. Our strength lies in our unity, discipline, and unwavering commitment to democratic values”. They, therefore, warned that continued protests amount to indiscipline and urged members to close ranks ahead of 2027. Aiyedatiwa Meets GAC, Seeks Reconciliation Following the outcome, Governor Aiyedatiwa met with the Governor’s Advisory Council, GAC, and other leaders in a closed-door session. In a communique after the closed door meeting, the leaders resolved to promote internal reconciliation, strengthen party cohesion and uphold the unity and progressive ideals of the APC in Ondo State. GAC Chairman, Chief Pius Akinyelure, said the meeting was aimed at reconciliation and strengthening party cohesion. Akinyelure noted that unity remains the party’s greatest strength, adding that disagreements from political contests are normal in a democracy and can be settled through dialogue, respect and sacrifice. He urged leaders and government officials to work together ahead of 2027 to surpass the state’s 2023 performance, when Ondo recorded the second-highest percentage of votes for Tinubu nationwide. On his part, the party’s South-West Vice Chairman, Hon. Isaac Kekemeke, now a Senatorial candidate, reaffirmed the states support for President Tinubu’s second term and appealed to the party’s national leadership to carry all stakeholders along in decisions affecting the state chapter. NASS candidates laud Tinubu, Yilwatda, Tunji-Ojo The successful candidates also called for calm, noting: “We can only forge ahead in unity and mutual trust. We must remain one indivisible family if we are to continue the great work we have begun in our Federal Constituency”. They lauded President Bola Tinubu and the party’s chairman, Professor Nentawe Yilwatda, for providing leadership defined by uncommon candour, an unyielding commitment to fairness, and unwavering dedication to equity. “Division is a luxury we cannot afford. Our unity is more important,” they said in a joint statement. To the Minister of Interior, Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, the candidates said that his “thoughtful interventions at the most critical moments, especially within our state, created the very conditions that made this journey possible”. They added that his “commitment to party cohesion and institutional, legislative leverage remains unmatched”. The post Ondo APC: How Aiyedatiwa’s consensus gamble on NASS candidates backfired appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Rodri set to undergo back surgery
items.description: World Cup winner Rodri will have surgery on a back issue on Monday, new Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca has confirmed. The 30-year-old Spain captain guided his country to World Cup glory last week and was named the Golden Ball winner as player of the tournament. But the midfielder’s last two seasons at club level were heavily disrupted – an anterior cruciate ligament injury leaving him sidelined for the majority of the 2024-25 campaign before several setbacks last season meant he was often unavailable. The Ballon d’Or winner was back to his best at the World Cup but, speaking at his first news conference since being appointed City boss, Maresca said Rodri now needs surgery followed by recuperation. “Now, [he has] surgery on Monday. Then he needs a holiday, he needs to rest and recover and then he will be back with us,” the Italian coach said. Maresca did not elaborate on when Rodri might return though he did dismiss speculation around the Spaniard’s future at Etihad Stadium following reports in the past week linking him with a move to Real Madrid. “Around big players there are always speculations so I am not worried about that,” he said. “I think it is normal, also because they [Spain] won the World Cup and because he is one of the best players. I think every manager wants to have Rodri because he is a top player.” Of other players still to return, Maresca said he expected to have them in the squad three or four days before City face Premier League champions Arsenal in the Community Shield on Sunday, 16 August. ‘A privilege’ to succeed Guardiola In his first news conference since succeeding Pep Guardiola last month, Maresca found himself fielding questions about the Catalan, who won 20 trophies in his 10 years at the club. The 46-year-old knows only too well the tough act he has to follow having worked as Guardiola’s assistant during the 2022-23 Treble-winning season. “I want to say it is a privilege because it’s the reason why the club decided to go for me, that is a privilege,” he said. “I have said many times, I consider Pep the best coach in the world in the last 20-25 years. It is a challenge [to replace him].” Maresca, who called time on his time at Chelsea in January after 18 months, acknowledged the challenge of arriving at a club who have had just three managers in 16 years. “That is not normal and has not happened often,” he said. “I am confident that we can continue to do a great job and continue to do the job that has been done in the last 14, 15 years since Roberto Mancini was here. “I know the organisation quite well and the people inside the club from years ago. The structure understands to give time for everything. “Since Manchester City contacted me, I had no doubt about joining this fantastic club.” Maresca hinted that there were “a few things to do” in the transfer window but would not be drawn on the futures of players including goalkeeper James Trafford, who has been linked with a move away from the club, and returning midfielder Jack Grealish, who spent last season on loan at Everton but is back in training with City.

items.title: IOC says Infantino complaint outside its scope
items.description: The International Olympic Committee says it will not investigate Gianni Infantino as a complaint about the FIFA president is outside its scope. Human rights campaign group FairSquare complained to the IOC that Infantino had breached its charter by failing to adhere to rules on political neutrality “through statements or other clear expressions of support for the US president”. US President Donald Trump admitted during the World Cup that he had called Infantino to ask him to review a red card given to US striker Folarin Balogun. The forward was expected to miss his side’s last-16 tie against Belgium after being sent off during their 2-0 win over Bosnia-Herzegovina. But after the intervention from Trump, the one-match ban was suspended for 12 months. No reason was given, beyond citing a rule that allows punishments to be suspended. Balogun started the match, which Belgium won 4-1. Infantino has been a member of the IOC since 2020. Section two of the Olympic Charter states: “Members of the IOC will not accept from governments, organisations, or other parties, any mandate or instructions liable to interfere with the freedom of their action and vote.” The IOC said the complaint against Infantino fell outside the jurisdiction of its ethics commission. “The current complaint, with regard to the FIFA president, refers only to the international federation’s decisions on its governance and its management, including its relations with government, and to the international federation’s implementation of the rules of its sport, which are both outside the scope of application of the IOC code of ethics,” it said. The IOC statement came a day after it emerged the Norwegian Football Federation was considering filing a formal complaint to Fifa’s ethics committee about the decision to suspend Balogun’s automatic one-match ban. In a statement provided to the BBC, NFF president Lise Klaveness said the federation had reacted with “strong concern” and that a decision on whether to file a complaint would be made at its next board meeting. The federation has already filed a complaint about Fifa’s first Peace Prize being awarded to Trump. FIFA has been contacted for comment.

items.title: Última hora de los incendios forestales, en directo | Marlaska: “Estamos enfrentando el incendio más importante y agresivo de la historia de España”
items.description: El ministro del Interior, Fernando Grande-Marlaska, ha informado tras la reunión del Cecod en el Puesto de Mando Avanzado de Navalcarnero de que la evolución de los incendios es “más favorable que ayer”, aunque se avanza “muy despacio” y las condiciones meteorológicas no están siendo favorables. El ministro ha advertido de que los servicios de extinción se enfrentan en Ávila al fuego “más importante y agresivo de la historia de España”. Marlaska ha cifrado en 47.000 las hectáreas calcinadas en esta provincia, aunque previamente Sara Aagesen, ministra para la Transición Ecológica, había hablado de 50.000 hectáreas. Aagesen ha explicado que se han calcinado 153.000 hectáreas en lo que va de año, una superficie seis veces superior a la registrada en el mismo periodo de 2025, y se han contabilizado 32 grandes incendios forestales. items.title: CAN féminine Maroc 2026 : Belle entrée en lice des Lionnes de l’Atlas qui rugissent face au Kenya
items.description: L’équipe nationale féminine du Maroc s’est largement imposée face à son homologue kényane sur le score sans appel de 4 buts à 0, en match de la 1ère journée du groupe A de la Coupe d’Afrique des nations féminine Maroc-2026, disputé dimanche soir au Stade Moulay El Hassan à Rabat. S’accaparant le jeu dès le coup de sifflet du coup d’envoi de la rencontre, les Lionnes de l’Atlas ont affiché leur penchant offensif pour tenter d’ouvrir le score par le biais de Sanaa Mssoudy et Ibtissam Jraidi. La première menace a été du côté des kényanes qui ont tenté de concrétiser à la 6e minute, une tentative avortée par le dégagement du ballon par la gardienne Khadija Er-Rmichi. Les Lionnes de l’Atlas ont aussitôt répliqué à la 8e minute par Sakina Ouzraoui agréablement servie par la très dynamique en surface de réparation adverse, Sanaa Mssoudy, s’ensuit un coup arrêté de Ouzraoui repris de la tête par Nouhaila Benzina qui a failli tromper la vigilance de la gardienne kényane Lilian Onyango (10e). L’ouverture du score des Lionnes de l’Atlas est intervenue à la 19e minute par Sakina Ouzraoui qui a conclu une passe décisive de Yasmin Mrabet. Ce but a poussé les joueuses kényanes à chercher l’égalisation avec une tentative non conclue de Valérie Nekesa (23e) qui a déjoué la vigilance de la défense marocaine. Après cette alerte, les protégées de Jorge Vilda ont déroulé leur rouleau compresseur offensif et ont parvenu à creuser l’écart grâce à Maryame Atiq (29e), qui a repris de la tête un corner joué par Kawtar Azraf, et Ibtissam Jraidi (32e) qui a concrétisé une passe décisive de Hanane Ait El Haj. De retour des vestiaires, les Lionnes de l’Atlas ont maintenu leur cadence offensive qui leur a permis d’accentuer l’écart avec un but de Ibtissam Jraidi (47e), qui signe un doublé. Non rassasiées, les coéquipières de Ghizlane Chebbak, qui n’a pas été alignée lors de ce match d’ouverture, ont maintenu leur pression pour alourdir le score, mais sans impact sur le résultat final de la rencontre. Maîtrisant leur jeu dans tous les compartiments, les Lionnes de l’Atlas ont livré une prestation convaincante pour leur son entrée en matière et un résultat qui traduit leur ambition à aller le plus loin possible dans cette compétition continentale. The post CAN féminine Maroc 2026 : Belle entrée en lice des Lionnes de l’Atlas qui rugissent face au Kenya appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Kane set for talks with Bayern Munich over new deal
items.description: Harry Kane is set to open formal talks with Bayern Munich over a new contract with the German champions. England captain Kane’s current deal expires at the end of the coming season, but Bayern are keen to extend the striker’s stay. It is understood the 32-year-old is aware of the Bundesliga club’s intention to offer him a new contract, with discussions expected to progress in the coming weeks. Kane joined Bayern from Tottenham in 2023 in a deal worth a reported £86m. The striker has enjoyed great success in Munich, helping the club win two Bundesliga titles and the German Cup. Kane, who scored six goals for England at the recent World Cup, has scored 146 goals in 134 appearances for Bayern since his arrival. Despite Bayern’s desire to tie him down to a new deal, Kane continues to attract interest from clubs across Europe and beyond. Barcelona have a long-standing interest in the England captain, while clubs in Saudi Arabia have also been linked with the centre-forward.

items.title: Howe unsure over Guimaraes amid Arsenal interest
items.description: Newcastle United head coach Eddie Howe says he has had positive discussions with Bruno Guimaraes but is unable to offer any guarantees on his captain’s future. BBC Sport reported this week that Arsenal are set to make a £70m offer for the Brazil midfielder, but Newcastle do not want to lose their talisman. “I’ve had some really good conversations with him before the World Cup, during the World Cup and after the World Cup,” Howe said after Newcastle ‘s 1-1 draw against Gateshead in a pre-season friendly on Saturday. “What we speak about has to remain private, but he’s just a great player, a great person. “I don’t know what’s going to happen with Bruno’s future. That’s for other people to speculate about. They are conversations that I’m not part of.” Guimaraes has been on holiday with his family following Brazil’s last-16 exit from the World Cup at the hands of Norway this month. He is due to return to Newcastle on Friday and fly out with the squad for a pre-season training camp in Spain. Comparisons have been made with Liverpool ‘s pursuit of Alexander Isak last summer – the striker ultimately pushed to leave Newcastle – but Howe said there is “nothing to say Bruno won’t be back training with us”. “You’ve got to look at it in its own right,” he said. “Bruno is the captain of our football club. He’s been an unbelievable player and person all through the time we have worked together. “I speak on behalf of everyone at the football club. We absolutely love him and, of course, everyone will want him to stay.” Steur catches the eye as midfield rebuilt Newcastle ‘s midfield has been weakened by the departure of Sandro Tonali, who joined Tottenham this month in a deal worth up to £100m. Young midfielders Sean Steur and Aladji Bamba have since arrived from Ajax and Monaco respectively. Although Saturday’s game came too soon for Bamba, whose move was announced on Friday, Steur played 90 minutes. “He played really well today,” Howe said. “He can be really pleased with his performance and first showing in Newcastle colours.” It is rare for an academy graduate to leave Ajax at 18, and for a fee worth up to £23m. However, Newcastle have to take calculated risks before potential signings like Steur potentially explode in value and are out of reach. Dutchman Steur clearly has promise. Willem Weijs, who managed Steur at Jong Ajax – the club’s reserve side – has described him as “one of the highest-rated” players in their academy. There were glimpses of Steur’s technical ability, composure and vision against National League side Gateshead. But he will need time to adapt to the physicality and intensity of the Premier League. “He’s outstanding in his first touches and creating options when playing a possession game,” Weijs said. “He’s good at scanning; really comfortable on the ball; really good in tight spaces. “He’s a typical Dutch-type midfield player, but he should focus on his points to develop as well, which is for sure the defensive part. “He should compete better in the duels, spending much more time in the gym. I know he’s working on that, but he can improve and he has to improve.” Newcastle have shifted strategy this summer, targeting players aged 20 and under and based on the continent. Steur, Bamba and fellow newcomers Ewen Jaouen and Bazoumana Toure will need patience. It is one of the many reasons why Howe will desperately want to keep hold of Guimaraes, having lost Isak, Tonali and Anthony Gordon in the past year. “We all need to be very supportive to the players that have come in,” Howe said. “I don’t think we can put too much pressure on them. It’s part of my job to try and take the pressure off them and allow them to develop and to enjoy their time here.”

items.title: Japan legend Miura, 59, scores first goal since 2022
items.description: Kazuyoshi Miura, the world’s oldest professional footballer, scored his first goal in nearly four years at the age of 59 for Japanese third-tier side Fukushima United. Miura found the net in the 52nd minute to make it 5-0 to Fukushima in an eventual 7-0 win over Iwaki Furukawa in the Emperor’s Cup on Saturday. It is his first competitive goal since netting for Suzuka PG, now Atletico Suzuka, against FC Osaka in November 2022. Dubbed ‘King Kazu’ in Japan, he is one of the country’s most loved sportsmen and was the face of the J League when it launched in 1993. He started his career with Brazilian side Santos in 1986 and has also played club football in Italy, Croatia and Australia. The forward’s long career will enter a 42nd season after extending his loan at Fukushima from J2 League side Yokohama FC until June 2027. Miura signed for Yokohama in 2005 but has not played a minute for them since 2020. He scored 55 goals in 89 games for Japan and has previously talked about playing into his 60s.

items.title: Richarlison scores as Spurs beat Auckland at Eden Park
items.description: Tottenham manager Roberto de Zerbi said he did not want to take any risks as he fielded a young side in a pre-season win against A-League champions Auckland FC in New Zealand. Dane Scarlett and Richarlison scored the goals for Spurs as Mateus Fernandes, an £85m signing from West Ham, was the only one of the club’s major summer arrivals to feature. Sandro Tonali, who joined Tottenham in a £100m deal from Newcastle United, missed out with “one small problem”, while defenders Jan Paul van Hecke, Andy Robertson and Marcos Senesi also didn’t figure. “It’s a chance for the young players,” De Zerbi told TVNZ before kick-off. “After a very long trip, we can’t take a risk with the players who are not ready to play yet.” Scarlett put Spurs into an early lead before some of Tottenham’s more experienced players in Ben Davies, Mathys Tel, Conor Gallagher and Richarlison came on, along with Fernandes, just after the hour mark. Richarlison added his side’s second in a game watched by a record crowd for a men’s football game in New Zealand. There were 40,112 at Eden Park, a ground where the usual occupants, the All Blacks, are unbeaten in 32 years , as the figure surpassed the previous best of 37,034 who turned up when the New Zealand men’s team played a World Cup qualifier against Peru in 2017. Tottenham’s next game is against Sydney FC on 29 July (10:45 BST).

items.title: CCMG calls for migration governance to be decentralised to district assemblies
items.description: The National President of the Coalition of Civil Society Organisations on Migration in Ghana (CCMG), Eric Boakye Peasah, has called on the government to decentralise migration governance by empowering metropolitan, municipal and district assemblies (MMDAs) to manage migration-related issues within their jurisdictions. He argued that because foreign nationals are present in communities across the country, migration governance should no longer be handled primarily from the national level. Speaking to MyJoyOnline at the close of the two-day 2026 Post-International Migration Review Forum (IMRF) National Stakeholder Dialogue, organised by CCMG in partnership with GIZ and the Merian Institute for Advanced Studies in Africa (MIASA) at the University of Ghana, Mr Boakye Peasah said migration was not merely a national issue discussed in Accra but one that played out largely at the local level. “In reality, most migration activities, challenges and opportunities play out at the local level,” he said. “A critical look at the issue will reveal that migration governance takes place more at the local level. So managing migration governance should also take place more within the districts.” He said the country had managed migration centrally for many years but believed the responsibility should now be assigned to district and municipal assemblies. District assemblies already taking first steps. Mr Boakye Peasah revealed that progress towards decentralising migration governance was already underway. According to him, the National Development Planning Commission (NDPC) this year introduced a policy requiring every district assembly to incorporate migration into its development agenda. He described the move as the “first step” towards effective decentralisation of migration management. However, he noted that the assemblies would require more than policy directives to perform the role effectively. “They all need information for planning, response and support services,” he said. Prof. Stefan Rother, Co-Director (Germany) of MIASA Proposal for digital migration platform To bridge the information gap, the CCMG President proposed the establishment of a dedicated digital platform for metropolitan, municipal and district assemblies. He explained that the platform could serve as a central repository for migration data, policy guidance and public education. “With this digital platform, the assembly can even provide basic information as a beginning point. It can be a step ahead,” he said. According to him, such a platform would enable local authorities to monitor migration trends, support migrants and returnees, and improve coordination with national institutions. Condemns xenophobic attacks in South Africa Commenting on the recent xenophobic attacks against African nationals in South Africa, Mr Boakye Peasah condemned the violence and called on the African Union to take decisive action. He expressed disappointment that South Africans appeared to have forgotten the support they received from other African countries, including Ghana, during the country’s liberation struggle. “It is disappointing that South Africans have failed to remember the massive support the country received from African countries, including Ghana, during the liberation struggle,” he said. “We must protect the spirit of African solidarity and hold member states accountable when that spirit is violated.” He added that CCMG and its partners would continue advocating humane migration policies in Ghana and across Africa, with a strong emphasis on protecting the rights and dignity of migrants. Lamisi Dabire, Communications Consultant GIZ calls for collaborative approach The Implementation Manager and Programme Component Manager for the Development-oriented Migration Programme at GIZ, Abena Owusua Amponsah-Bio, also called for a collaborative and evidence-based approach to migration governance. She said migration created opportunities for economic growth, innovation, cultural exchange and development while also presenting complex challenges that required evidence-based responses. “Migration creates opportunities for economic growth, innovation, cultural exchange and development, while also presenting complex challenges that require evidence-based approaches,” she said. She noted that migration intersects with labour mobility, climate change, regional integration, human rights, security and sustainable development, making collaboration essential. “No single institution can address these issues alone,” she said. She further stressed the importance of reflecting on global migration processes such as the International Migration Review Forum. “As we think generationally, our journey in migration management in Ghana should involve reflection on important global processes such as the IMRF. This is key for Ghana’s positioning in the migration management ecosystem and for fostering continuous learning in a country that is doing so well.” Abena Owusua Amponsah-Bio Ministry urges implementation of IMRF commitments A speech delivered on behalf of the Director of the Migration Directorate at the Ministry of the Interior, Freda Agyei Asare, highlighted the critical role civil society organisations continue to play in Ghana’s migration governance framework. She said stakeholders must now move beyond dialogue and focus on implementing the commitments emerging from the 2026 International Migration Review Forum. “As key stakeholders, our responsibility extends beyond dialogue. We must now focus on translating the commitments and lessons emerging from the 2026 IMRF into practical national actions,” she said. Ms Agyei Asare noted that Ghana’s delegation, led by the Minister for the Interior, Muntaka Mohammed-Mubarak, actively participated in the 2026 IMRF held in New York from 4 to 8 May 2026. She said that as a Champion Country, Ghana co-chaired high-level sessions and hosted side events on labour migration, fair recruitment, diaspora contributions and local governance. According to her, the Forum helped identify gaps in Ghana’s migration framework while strengthening bilateral cooperation, renewing commitment to the National Coordination Mechanism (NCM) and generating increased support for migration programmes. “Through stronger collaboration and coordinated implementation, we can collectively advance safe, orderly and regular migration in line with Ghana’s national development priorities.”

items.title: Sanoyah : Deux personnes périssent dans un horrible accident
items.description: Cet accident de la circulation s'est produit dans la soirée de ce dimanche au kilomètre 36, dans la commune urbaine de Sanoyah. Le drame a coûté la vie à deux personnes : un conducteur de taxi-moto et sa passagère, broyés sur les lieux de l'accident. Selon les premiers témoignages recueillis sur place, un camion transportant un conteneur est entré en collision avec une moto-taxi. D'après plusieurs témoins, le poids lourd aurait percuté la moto par l'arrière avant de la traîner sur plusieurs mètres. L'engin à deux roues s'est finalement retrouvé coincé sous les roues du camion. Présent sur les lieux, un témoin, caméraman de profession, a décrit une scène particulièrement choquante : « Nous avons vu le camion traîner la moto sur une longue distance avant de s'immobiliser. C'était une scène absolument insoutenable. » Les deux victimes n'ont malheureusement pas survécu à la violence du choc. La passagère, identifiée grâce à sa carte nationale d'identité, exerçait comme vendeuse de médicaments, selon des sources présentes sur les lieux. Le drame a suscité une vive émotion parmi les habitants et les nombreux curieux qui se sont rassemblés autour du site de l'accident. Les forces de sécurité ainsi que les autorités locales sont rapidement intervenues pour sécuriser le périmètre, effectuer les premières constatations et faciliter les opérations de secours. Les dépouilles ont ensuite été évacuées vers l'hôpital régional d'Enta, où elles seront remises aux familles pour les formalités d'usage et les obsèques. Une enquête devrait permettre de déterminer avec précision les circonstances et les responsabilités liées à cet accident.

items.title: Gittens keen to impress ‘world-class’ Alonso
items.description: Chelsea winger Jamie Gittens says he will be involved in Xabi Alonso’s squad next season and describes his new manager as “one of the best to do it”. The 21-year-old joined the Blues from Borussia Dortmund in a £52m deal last summer but struggled to make a major impact in his first season at Stamford Bridge. Asked whether he had been told he was part of Alonso’s plans, Gittens initially replied: “Yeah.” He continued: “He just wants me to keep being positive, to keep taking on players, to keep creating chances and to keep pushing myself to the maximum.” Gittens added that the squad respect Alonso because he was a “world-class midfielder” during his playing career with Real Madrid and Liverpool, among others. He also said that when he faced Alonso’s Bayer Leverkusen side while playing in Germany, it was “really hard”. Leverkusen won the Bundesliga title and German Cup in Alonso’s first full season in charge. Gittens added: “They were really a team.” Team cohesion was something Chelsea lacked last season as they finished 10th in the Premier League, failed to qualify for European football and ended the campaign without a trophy. However, he is confident that signings like £117m British transfer record Morgan Rogers, who he played with in Manchester City’s academy, “will raise the bar” and that Chelsea retain an ambition to “win everything”. Gittens is also back on track having scored in Alonso’s first two matches behind closed doors against EFL clubs Crawley and Bromley, having suffered a hamstring injury in January and missing the back end of last season. He insists he is “90% fit” after a holiday training camp in Portugal and Spain. However, he admitted: “It has been hard because this was the first muscle injury I’ve had. I’m feeling much better, the hamstrings are good. “I want to succeed here. I need to show people what I can do. I’ve shown small glimpses, I would say, but this season will be a good season.”

items.title: De Tanger à Changsha : Les médias marocains et chinois explorent de nouveaux horizons communs
items.description: Une délégation de journalistes marocains, dont Hespress FR a fait partie, a tenu une réunion d'échanges avec des journalistes et producteurs de télévision du groupe TVZone Media, à Changsha, en Chine. La réunion a permis de discuter des tendances audiovisuelles et médiatiques dans la région du Hunan ainsi que des opportunités de collaboration avec les médias marocains. Lors de leurs échanges, la partie chinoise et la partie marocaine ont évoqué leur volonté de collaborer dans la production de contenus mettant en avant la culture et les spécificités du Maroc, notamment en raison du grand intérêt porté par la Chine à l'approfondissement des liens avec le continent africain. Qi Ying, collaboratrice au sein de la chaîne internationale de Hunan Broadcasting System, a souligné l'accent mis par la chaîne sur l'Afrique en expliquant que l'objectif est de mettre en avant la région du Hunan auprès du public africain et de faire connaître la culture africaine auprès du public chinois. Elle a évoqué une émission culinaire autour de la cuisine du Hunan -connue pour être relevée en épices-, tournée en France, ainsi qu'une émission tournée dans un restaurant chinois à Tanger. « Nous avons tourné une émission de talents en Afrique, et certaines de ces femmes qui ont été révélées au public ont pu changer de condition économique et sociale grâce à l'exposition médiatique », a-t-elle déclaré, ajoutant qu'en ce moment la chanteuse marocaine Faouzia, auteure du tube « Tears of Gold », se trouve dans le Hunan pour découvrir la région. Pendant la visite des locaux de la société de production dont des studios destinés aux tournages d'émissions et plateaux télévisés, He Zhuo, directeur commercial du département de contenu de Zhongguang Tianze, a présenté les grands succès de production de la boîte, notamment des séries tournées localement dans la région et ayant acquis une notoriété dans toute la Chine. Il a évoqué notamment le succès retentissant d'une télé-réalité tournée dans le poste de police de la ville de Changsha, la capitale du Hunan. Ce commissariat a gagné en popularité depuis le lancement de la série au point de devenir un endroit touristique que les visiteurs prennent en photo. Les contenus du groupe, qui compte également une chaîne de télévision informative ainsi qu'un site internet, se distinguent par leur proximité avec leur public et leur intérêt au point de parfois dépasser la CCTV, le groupe national de télévision, en audiences. Bien que le groupe TVZone Media soit régional, son succès dépasse sa zone géographique. Certaines de ses productions trouvent de l'écho dans d'autres pays asiatiques, a fait savoir Fang Zhenxiang, directeur adjoint du Service de la communication internationale et des études politiques au Bureau des affaires étrangères de la province du Hunan. Ce succès s'explique notamment par l'originalité des programmes ainsi que par les réponses fournies par les médias aux préoccupations quotidiennes des citoyens. Dans ce cadre, Wang Yang, journaliste pour le site Rednet, qui se spécialise dans le journalisme régional et de proximité, a expliqué qu'en plus d'informer le public des changements et informations sur la scène politique régionale, le site déploie plus d'une centaine de journalistes pour rapporter des informations locales. Il a également expliqué que le site a instauré un espace de commentaires où les utilisateurs peuvent partager leurs réactions et suggestions pour l'amélioration de la vie quotidienne des citoyens. À travers cet outil, les propositions retenues sont transmises aux autorités qui peuvent par la suite décider de les appliquer. Cela a permis notamment d'ouvrir l'accès gratuit au principal site touristique de la ville de Changsha, l'île aux Oranges (Juzizhou), où se trouve la plus grande statue de Mao Zedong, d'une hauteur de plus de 32 mètres. Cette rencontre entre les représentants des médias marocains et leurs homologues chinois, qui a servi de prise de contact et d'échange sur le fonctionnement du groupe TVZone Media, devrait ouvrir la voie au rapprochement des points de vue et sans doute jeter les bases d'une collaboration future entre médias marocains et chinois, l'un des ponts culturels, sociaux, diplomatiques et économiques les plus pertinents. The post De Tanger à Changsha : Les médias marocains et chinois explorent de nouveaux horizons communs appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Campagne nationale de distribution de moustiquaires : L’opération démarrée dans la région de la Kara
items.description: Kara, 26 juil. (ATOP) – La campagne nationale de distribution gratuite de Moustiquaires imprégnées d’insecticide (MII) a débuté le dimanche 26 juillet dans la région de la Kara et se poursuivra jusqu’au 30 juillet prochain. Les responsables des ménages sont invités à aller retirer leurs moustiquaires sur les sites de distribution indiqués sur les coupons lors de la phase de dénombrement, notamment les centres de santé, les établissements scolaires et autres lieux publics aménagés. Le commissaire central et le DPS Kozah donnant une MII à une personne âgée au CMS Adabawéré Dans les préfectures de la Kozah, Kéran et Doufelgou notamment, les présidents du Comité local d’organisation (CLO) de distribution des MII, accompagnés de certains membres ont effectué une tournée pour s’assurer du bon déroulement de l’activité. Le président du CLO Kozah, Col. Bonfo Faré a lancé l’opération au Lycée Kara I, avant d’effectuer le tour sur certains des 69 sites. Il était accompagné du rapporteur et d’autres membres du CLO. Ils se sont rendus successivement au centre médico-social Adabawéré, EPP Centrale et Kara Sud, Tomdè, Lama Feing, ainsi qu’au CEG Landja. Le Colonel Bonfo a demandé aux équipes de respecter toutes les consignes données pour le succès de l’opération. Il a exhorté les distributeurs à suivre l’ordre d’arrivée tout en privilégiant les personnes âgées, handicapées et femmes enceintes. Le président a demandé aux bénéficiaires de bien utiliser les moustiquaires reçues afin de se prémunir de la piqûre des moustiques. « Nous avons constaté que les activités ont réellement démarré sur les sites visités et avons reçu les informations aussi qu’elles ont bien démarré dans d’autres communes sœurs, sans d’incidents majeurs. Sauf au début avec la synchronisation avec l’application, mais tout est corrigé et les équipes sont entrain de l’utiliser correctement avec les données du serveur », a indiqué le rapporteur du CLO Kozah, Dr. Alfa Abdel Kadère. Le président CLO Kozah donnant des conseils aux bénéficiaires sur le bon usage des MII (CEG Landja) A Kantè dans la préfecture de la Kéran , 93.650 MII soit 1.873 ballots, fournies par le Programme national de lutte contre le paludisme (PNLP) sont disponibles sur les 107 sites aménagés par le district sanitaire pour les 34.320 ménages dénombrés. Le ton de la campagne a été donné par le président du CLO MII-Kéran, Douti N’Sarma Mabiba, préfet de la localité en présence du DPS Kéran, Dr. Attipoé Yawovi Mawuena. Le président a rappelé aux membres du CLO, le rôle et les responsabilités dévolus à chacun, notamment, intensifier la sensibilisation et la mobilisation sociale pendant toute la durée de la campagne et coordonner toutes les activités entre les différents acteurs impliqués afin de garantir la réussite de ladite campagne. Dans le Doufelgou , 60.222 MII seront distribuées aux 103.541 ménages recensés. Le président du CLO, Col. Aziaba Ayi Sessi, a invité la population à utiliser impérativement ces moustiquaires afin d’éviter le paludisme. ATOP/TAL/SG/BV

items.title: 2027: Tinubu should retire, Nigeria needs fresh leadership — Obi
items.description: The presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peter Obi, has called on President Bola Tinubu to step aside before the 2027 general election, saying Nigeria requires a more energetic and capable leader to tackle its worsening economic hardship and security challenges. Speaking on Channels Television’s Sunday Politics, Obi argued that Tinubu’s administration has failed to provide the leadership needed to address the country’s growing crises. He said the president no longer possesses the capacity required to govern effectively. According to Obi, there is a stark contrast between Tinubu’s years as governor of Lagos State and his current performance as president. “The Bola Tinubu that was governor is not the one that is president today. He’s tired. He should be allowed to retire in peace and then go home,” he said. The former Anambra State governor maintained that Nigeria was heading in the wrong direction under the current administration, insisting that the country needed a change in leadership. “As it is right now, Bola Tinubu is leading us nowhere. We will turn it so he can see it. That’s why maybe I’m calling for his retirement. The man should just step aside. Yes, he doesn’t have the capacity to do the job,” he said. Obi urged Nigerians to shift attention away from political calculations and focus on pressing national issues such as poverty, hunger, education and insecurity. Citing recent global projections, he said nearly 79 per cent of Nigerians could fall below the poverty line, while millions were also at risk of food insecurity. Reacting to comments by United States President Donald Trump praising Tinubu’s efforts against insecurity, Obi acknowledged the commendation but insisted the government’s response remained inadequate. “Thank you to Donald Trump. Thank you to President Trump. But we need to do more, far more than what we are doing,” he said. “I’ve heard people, and Donald Trump is now confirming it, say he has done his best. But with the crisis we are facing, his best is not enough. We need to do more.” The post 2027: Tinubu should retire, Nigeria needs fresh leadership — Obi appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: CAN 2026 féminine : l’Algérie domine le Sénégal, avant le choc contre le Maroc
items.description: L’équipe d’Algérie féminine a bien entamé la CAN 2026 au Maroc avec une belle victoire contre le Sénégal (2-0) ce dimanche 26 juillet au stade olympique de Rabat pour le compte de la première journée du groupe A. Les Vertes ont frappé à deux reprises par Marine Dafeur (42e, sur penalty) et Melissa Bethi (88e). Après un début de match équilibré où les deux sélections se rendaient coup pour coup, les Algériennes ont pris l’avantage sur penalty après le fauchage d’Amira Braham dans la surface de réparation sénégalaise. Marine Dafeur n’a laissé aucune chance à la gardienne des Lionnes de la Teranga, Khady Faye (1-0, 42 e ). CAN 2026 féminine : l’Algérie bat le Sénégal et attend le Maroc En seconde période, l’Algérie a su comment contenir les assauts du Sénégal pour l’égalisation, avant d’assommer son adversaire, à deux minutes de la fin du temps réglementaire, à la suite d’une grossière erreur de dégagement de la gardienne Faye. Lina Boussaha récupère le ballon et sert Melissa Bethi, qui fait le break pour sceller la victoire des Vertes. Cette victoire permet aux camarades de Sofia Guellati de bien se lancer dans la compétition, avant le choc contre le Maroc lors de la 2 e journée du premier tour. L’Algérie est tombée dans le groupe avec le pays hôte, le Sénégal et le Kenya. L’ambition des Vertes est de faire mieux que l’édition précédente où elles avaient atteint les quarts de finale.
